Check a new measurement before it is staged

dot-upd_ind_measure_check.Rd

Problems that stop the value from being staged: * `census_missing`: the feature belongs to a census and none was chosen. * `duplicate`: a value of this feature is already stored, or staged, for the same census (or, for a feature never linked to a census, at all). Edit the stored one in section 4 instead. * `below_min` / `above_max`: outside the feature's allowed range.

Usage

.upd_ind_measure_check(
  row,
  trait,
  policy = "always",
  stored = NULL,
  staged = NULL,
  censuses = NULL
)

Arguments

row

One-row data frame from [.upd_ind_measure_row()].

trait

One-row data frame of `traitlist` (`valuetype`, and `minallowedvalue`, `maxallowedvalue` when present).

policy

`"always"` or `"never"`, from [.feature_census_link()].

stored

Data frame from [.upd_ind_stored_measures()], or `NULL`.

staged

Measurements already staged, or `NULL`.

censuses

Data frame from [.upd_plot_censuses()], or `NULL`.

Value

A list with `errors` and `warnings` (character vectors of the codes above) and `row`, with `id_sub_plots` cleared for a feature never linked to a census and `issue` completed for a warning.

Details

And one that only warns, recorded in `issue` the way `add_traits_measures()` records it: * `lower_than_previous`: a numeric value lower than the largest value of the same feature at an earlier census.
